title: Research: flag-0 tail self-owned X0 host schedule S0 at 5758/5759/5807 (answers #3669 OQ2; no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6 answering [#3669](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3669) OQ2: does the published promote/add/restore at 5758/5759/5807 admit an owner/host schedule for the `X0` read that restores arbitrary dirt without repaying the unrestored channel endpoints?

On present-head flag 0, that cut admits self-owned host schedule **S0** (`owner=X0` on `FULL`):

- Unique among registers named by ADD 5759 (`unique_owner=1`)
- Zero dirty-helper touches in the window (`dirty_helper_touches=0`)
- Zero endpoint repayment toward initials (`endpoint_repay=0`)
- Pre-read `X0` restoration blocked by the published common-chart annotation (`pre_read_restore_blocks=1`)

S0 is an **interpretive** owner/host assignment on the published #2089 word; compatible with jwr404 `p104-tail-flag0-owner` (`owner_assigned=False` / `owner_field=False`). “Arbitrary dirt restoration” here means zero dirty-helper touches in 5758–5807 (channel dirt undisturbed), not a new dirt-restore construction. Uniqueness holds only among registers named by ADD 5759; copied-host alternatives and a global 104×104 map remain open. Pre-read obstruction is the static chart conflict `[232] ≠ FULL`, not a priced post-5807 repay bill.

Does not answer #3669 OQ1 or retarget [#3532](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3532).

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/p104-flag0-tail-owner-host/`
- Tip: `9a53c8ad9ac5ba8ad1a77907f66ac2529c947829`
- Content tip: `01cbbe3450d00afd57fbd529d8d9c7f6cc3d776c`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **changed** — S0 owner/host assignment + dirt/repay/obstruction on the published tail cut

Closest priors: [#3669](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3669) (leave alone; OQ2 answered), jwr404 `p104-tail-flag0-*` (soft-overlap ≈0.20–0.28; complementary gap-fill), deferred `p104-flag0-head-span-schedule` / [#3532](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3532) (different cut; soft-overlap ≈0.08). Side-correction and present-head chronology leave-alones untouched.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-flag0-tail-owner-host/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag0-tail-owner-host/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag0-tail-owner-host/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag0-tail-owner-host/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-flag0-tail-owner-host
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_FLAG0_TAIL_OWNER_HOST flag=0 owner=X0 promote=5758 add=5759 restore=5807 dirty_helper_touches=0 endpoint_repay=0 pre_read_restore_blocks=1 unique_owner=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG0_TAIL_OWNER_HOST_INDEPENDENT flag=0 owner=X0 promote=5758 add=5759 restore=5807 dirty_helper_touches=0 endpoint_repay=0 pre_read_restore_blocks=1 unique_owner=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG0_TAIL_OWNER_HOST_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-flag0-tail-owner-host outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Credit

Credit #3669 OQ2, #2089 / Cinna Davis, jwr404 `p104-tail-flag0-*`, #3349, and the retained P104 present-head lineage. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Does any non-self / copied-host alternative among event-named registers also achieve zero dirt-helper touches and zero endpoint repayment on this cut?
2. Can arbitrary dirt be restored under S0 without enlarging the published promote/add/restore window (constructed dirt-restore program)?
